name: Publir – Holistic Revenue Engine (HRE)
author: publirump

sections.description:
Publir’s Holistic Revenue Engine (HRE) plugin helps WordPress publishers increase revenue through two integrated solutions:

  • Dynamic Ad Optimization
  • Audience Monetization

Easily deploy high-paying programmatic ads, a premium subscription paywall, and clean user experiences with a single plugin.

Dynamic Ad Optimization Get the highest-paying ad on every page, across every device. Publir’s engine uses real-time header bidding, AI-based targeting, and 150+ ad tech integrations to maximize earnings — with fast, low-latency delivery.

Audience Monetization Convert casual readers into paid subscribers with smart paywalls, ad-free options, and flexible pricing. Use built-in reporting tools to grow your subscriber base and collect zero-party data.

Built for WordPress Publir HRE is tailor-made for WordPress. Whether you’re a solo creator or large publisher, you can integrate a complete monetization engine without code, complexity, or ad ops teams.

External Dependencies

We are using Amazon Web Services to track Ad block page views for our clients. To facilitate tracking, our plugin will call:
https://{amazon_service_node}.amazonaws.com/default/pAnalytics To fetch currency details and site-specific customizations, the plugin uses:
https://a.publir.com/subscriptions/{siteId}.json
sections.installation:
Follow these simple steps to set up and activate the Publir HRE plugin on your WordPress site:

Register on the Publir Platform

To get started, Login or Register on the Publir platform.

If you want to set up ads for your site:

  • Go to Setup > Dynamic Ad Optimization after logging in.
  • Complete the ad setup process to enable ad serving.

If you want to set up subscriptions:

  • Go to Audience Monetization > Settings.
  • Enter your pricing details and configure your subscription options.

Once you’re done, return to your WordPress dashboard to continue plugin installation and configuration.

Install the Plugin

  • Go to your WordPress Admin Dashboard.
  • Click on Plugins > Add New.
  • In the search box, type “Publir HRE” and press Enter.
  • Locate the Publir HRE plugin, and click Install Now.

Activate the Plugin

  • Once installation is complete, click the Activate button.

Configure the Plugin

  • After activation, navigate to Settings in your WordPress dashboard and select Publir HRE.

  • You’ll need the following information:

    • Publir Site ID:

      Obtain your Site ID by logging into your Publir account at Login. Your Site ID will be clearly displayed in your dashboard.

    • Register/Login Page URL:

      Enter the URL of your website’s registration/login page.

      (Example: https://yourdomain.com/register)

  • After entering these details, click Save Changes.

Confirm Installation

  • Visit your website in an incognito/private browser window to verify that Publir HRE is functioning correctly.

Troubleshooting and Support

If you encounter issues during installation or activation, contact our support team at support@publir.com.
sections.faq:
What is Publir?

Publir is a unified monetization platform, helping publishers grow revenue through smart advertising and subscriptions.

How soon can I expect growth in subscriptions?

Results vary, but most sites see steady subscriber growth with consistent content and promotion.

How long does setup take?

Account creation is self-service and takes about 5 minutes. You can register directly via Register

What are Publir’s current products?

  • Dynamic Ad Optimization
  • Audience Monetization

How difficult is it to implement the coding?

Our implementation guide is super simple, all you need to do is attach our header tag and insert the body tags where you would like the ads to appear. We do of course have our Ad Operations team available to assist in the implementation of the ad placements and are always available to join a call to guide you through the steps. An implementation guide is also readily available as well.

Can I use multiple products at once?

Yes! We encourage our new partners to explore the wide variety of the Publir products and many of our partners use majority of our products to monetize their websites be it.

What are your payment terms?

We offer net 30 payments in the form of ACH/Wire/Paypal whichever option is preferred. All payment documentation is provided during the onboarding process ensuring the payment processing team has the necessary information at hand to make the first payment at the precise time ensuring we never miss a payment which is a record we love to brag about!

Can I add multiple domains to your network?
